title: validate_sha256_format rejects uppercase hex from non-conformant servers
description: validate_sha256_format requires all lowercase hex. If a server implementing jmap-cid returns an uppercase or mixed-case sha256, upload_blob and download_blob return ClientError::Parse. Callers cannot distinguish this from a genuinely malformed field. Either accept both cases with normalisation before comparison, or document strictly-lowercase-only as a deliberate interop constraint.
